## I'm submitting a ...

[x] Bug report

[ ] Support request => Please do not submit support request here, instead see https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#question
## Current behavior When i open my ng2 app on ipad, animations goes wrong (some styles don't applied on elements) ## Expected behavior Everything works as expected (like on desktop) ## Minimal reproduction of the problem with instructions Create animations and open it on ipad. Animations: ```ts @Component({ ... animations: [ trigger('color', [ state('white', style({ backgroundColor: '#fff' })), state('red', style({ backgroundColor: '#e41e2b'})), transition('* => *', animate('250ms ease-in-out')), ]), trigger('visible', [ state('hide', style({ opacity: 0, visibility: 'hidden' })), state('show', style({ opacity: 1, visibility: 'visible' })), transition('* => *', animate('250ms ease-in-out')), ]), trigger('size', [ state('default', style({ transform: 'translateY(0)' })), state('large', style({ transform: 'translateY(11px)' })), transition('* => *', animate('250ms ease-in-out')), ]), ] }) ``` Template: ```html
